title: Understanding the DataFrame Structure
text: Look at how the second DataFrame is structured. Notice that both $$`player_{id}`$$ and $$`game_{type}`$$ are used as indices. This suggests that the data is grouped by these two columns.

title: Analyzing the Aggregation
text: The `win` column in the second DataFrame shows the average win value for each combination of $$`player_{id}`$$ and $$`game_{type}`$$. Think about which method can calculate the mean for grouped data.

title: Choosing the Right Method
text: Which method allows you to group data by multiple columns and then calculate the mean for each group?
